rent a boat

For the perfect holiday experience!

Coastal Boat Rentals is situated in the heart of the Garden Route, Knysna. One of South Africa’s most breath-taking holiday destination.

The Garden Route has many beautifull rivers and estuaries to explore and the best way to experience it is by boat. Whether it be skiing on Knysna Lagoon, fishing in Plettenberg bay or a sunsent cruise on Swartvlei, we have the right boat for you.

Have a look at our fleet and take your holiday to the next level.

View available boats!

Our Boats

Panache Charlie

Panache Charlie is an Angler Panache 1850 powered by a 200HP Yamaha VMAX motor. She a is a powerful luxary ski boat that can carry up to 8 people.

More Info

Infanta 5.2 (Bravo)

Infanta Bravo is a 5.2 infanta powered by a 90HP Yamaha motor. She is a great all rounder boat good for fishing and skiing.

More Info

Panache Alpha

Panache Alpha is a Panache 1850 LX fitted with a 200hp Yamaha HPDI fuel injected two stroke motor, making it very powerful but also economical. She is a luxury skiing boat with a wakeboard tower and can carry up to 8 people.

More Info

Explorer 510

The Explorer 510 is great cruising, fishing or skiing boat. The ultimate all rounder. She has a wet deck and powered by a 115HP Yamaha motor.

More Info

Panache Bravo

Panache Bravo is a Panache 1850 LX fitted with a powerfull 200HP Yamaha VMAX motor. She is a luxury skiing and cruising boat perfect for adventures on the water.
She can carry up to 8 poeple.

More Info

Fazer XT

The Fazer XT is a small ski boat. She can carry up to 7 people. Great for skiing or cruising the lagoons. Powered by a 115hp Yamaha motor.

More Info

Heart Craft 410

No skippers required for this 4.1m Heart Craft boat. Powered by a 15HP Yamaha motor.
She is light, easy to drive and has ample space for 5 people to explore the estuaries.

More Info

Falcon 5.2m

Falcon 5.2m is powered by a 90HP Honda Fourstroke motor. She is a great all rounder boat good for fishing and skiing. Very economical.

More Info

Panache Delta

Our Panache Delta is an Angler Panache 1850 LX fitted with a powerfull 200HP Yamaha VMAX motor. She is a speed boat, good for skiing and cruising.

More Info

Celebrity 170

The Celebrity 170 is a 5,2m pleasure craft. The Celebrity 170 is designed with water skiing, tubing, wakeboarding and general family boating in mind. The hull is filled with over 30% foam flotation, to meet the local inland, and protected waters requirements. She offers fantastic handling, great use of space, easy to tow, and is powered by a 130HP Yamaha outboard.

More Info
